# Independent CA evidence: claims and source pages

Selected institutional claims were subject to independent limited assurance by NPSY & Co. under SAE 3000, with a separate SRS 4400 report of factual findings. Both reports are dated 3 September 2026 and relate to records/claims as at 17 July 2026.
Issuer: NPSY & Co., Chartered Accountants
Signatory: N Prasada Rao, Partner
Signed: 2026-09-03
Cutoff: 2026-07-17
Original signed documents and annexures inspected. Both exact UDINs and practitioner/signing particulars matched on the live ICAI portal on 19 September 2026; both showed Active. Report scope and cutoff remain unchanged.

## Cumulative services
Within the specified report scope
31 million+ documented therapy services: floor subject to independent limited assurance; 31,052,382 recorded in the related factual-findings report at 17 July 2026.
Limited assurance on >=31,000,000 floor; 31,052,382 factual finding
Therapy service includes 1:1 therapy, structured assessments, screenings and parent training. It does not mean 31 million independently verified successful therapy sessions.
SAE 3000: p4 A1; p6 therapy-service definition
SRS 4400: p3 item1
Handout physical PDF pages: 1, 3, 14, 15, 19, 22

## Beneficiary / family registrations
Within the specified report scope
792,614 beneficiary/family registrations recorded under the stated counting criteria at 17 July 2026.
Limited assurance on >=790,000 floor; 792,614 factual finding
Unique beneficiary or family registration counted once under the criteria. Not a separate count of 792,614 unique children, households with home therapy, or proven clinical outcomes.
SAE 3000: p4 A2; p6 beneficiary/family-registration definition
SRS 4400: p3 item2
Handout physical PDF pages: 1, 3, 7, 14, 15, 19, 22

## Operational centres
Within the specified report scope
49 centres met the report's operational-centre criteria at the cutoff; seven were visited physically.
Limited assurance on >=40 floor; 49 factual finding
Operational means a location with lease/ownership rights, location registration/listing, staffing roster and platform activity in the preceding 90 days. The report names Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Delhi.
SAE 3000: p4 A3; p6 operational-centre definition
SRS 4400: p3 item3
Handout physical PDF pages: 3, 14

## Wider centre network
Separate source evidence
Handout p14 itself distinguishes 49 operational centres from network figure 70+.
Not established by these reports
The handout distinguishes the wider 70+ network from 49 centres meeting the operational criteria. Ownership and franchise status require their own records.
SAE 3000: No 70+ or wholly-owned-network assertion; A3 uses >=40 and allows lease or ownership.
SRS 4400: p3 item3 records 49, not 70+.
Handout physical PDF pages: 1, 3, 9, 14, 18, 19, 20, 21

## Network-trained practitioners
Within the specified report scope
2,293 network-trained and certified practitioners recorded; 83% women, at the cutoff.
Limited assurance on floors; 2,293 and 83% factual findings
Certification means completion of the network's defined training/certification pathway. It does not establish current employment, RCI registration, or independent professional licensure for every practitioner.
SAE 3000: p4 A4; p6 certified-practitioner definition
SRS 4400: p3 item4
Handout physical PDF pages: 3, 14, 18, 19, 20, 21

## Structured developmental records
Within the specified report scope
2.7 billion+ structured platform records recorded in the SRS 4400 factual findings; the SAE 3000 report covers a 2.5 billion+ floor.
Limited assurance on 2.5B+ floor; 2.7B+ separate factual finding
Structured records/events: session logs, assessment observations, technique ratings, sensor events or equivalent mapped fields. Not unique people, independent trial observations, or established deduplicated AI-training examples; no general IT-controls audit.
SAE 3000: p4 A5 assures >=2,500,000,000 floor; p6 data-point definition; p7 IT reliance
SRS 4400: p3 item5
Handout physical PDF pages: 3, 8, 9, 14, 15, 18, 19, 20

## Patent applications
Within the specified report scope
16 distinct applications per filing receipts, comprising 13 PCT and 3 Indian, without duplicate counting across phases; lead PCT checked on Patentscope.
Limited assurance on >=13 PCT floor; 16 distinct applications factual finding
Applications filed, not patents granted; no conclusion on novelty, enforceability, global exclusivity or every invention described.

## Methodology and protocol DOI records
Within the specified report scope
The practitioner checked the two cited DOI records and agreement of their stated particulars.
Publication existence/content-agreement within scope
The audit procedures do not replicate statistics or establish completed independent CRO validation. The second work is explicitly a validation protocol. DOI existence/content match does not establish journal peer review.
SAE 3000: p4 D2; p7 publication criterion
SRS 4400: p4 item12
Handout physical PDF pages: 3, 6, 8, 9, 14, 19, 21
